name: Blood & Ash
detailed_description:
As our game is still in development, there may be changes or additions to the visuals. Therefore, please note that some features and visuals may change before the full version of the game is released. Throughout our development process, we are working to add new features and content to the game and taking feedback from our players into consideration. By following our game, you can join us in the development process and be prepared for the full release of our game.

We will be releasing a demo for our game, which is still in development, soon. If you'd like to be notified when the demo is available, please don't forget to add our game to your Wishlist!

Valdoron was an ancient kingdom that had lived in peace and prosperity for many years. But everything changed with the rise of a dark evil from the east. The kingdom's cities began to fall one by one, its people slaughtered, and even the dead were turned into soldiers for the darkness as cursed spirits possessed their bodies.

Zalbanor, the kingdom's last line of defense, eventually fell. The king and most of his people were either killed or taken captive. Far in the northern lands, Arndur—the exiled heir to the throne—had been watching the kingdom’s slow descent into chaos. Though far from home, he had not turned his back on his people. Gathering strength and forging alliances in secret, he had been preparing for the day he would return.

When Zalbanor fell, Arndur knew the time had come. He could wait no longer. He set out on a perilous journey to reclaim his homeland and face the ancient enemies that had brought ruin to Valdoron.

But the darkness Arndur was about to confront was far greater than he had imagined. Witnessing the brutality of war up close, he found himself fighting not only an overwhelming enemy beyond his borders, but also a growing shadow within his own heart.

As Arndur gathered his courage and strength to save Valdoron, every step became a desperate struggle for survival. In this battle, Arndur wasn’t just fighting to restore a kingdom—he was fighting to save his very soul.
